title: Hooke scientific workspace acceptance cases
purpose: Engineering case inventory for the approved full implementation. These are procedure specifications, not implemented tests or runtime qualification.

cases.title: Navigate depth, time, and channels

reference.behavior: Non-displayed axes have bounded slice positions and numeric step entry.

cases.required_hooke_interface: View dimension controls and dimension API.
cases.fixture: Asymmetric TCZYX array with unequal dimensions and values encoding every index.
procedure: Move each non-displayed axis by slider, numeric entry, and keyboard.
Probe known pixels at each position.
cases.data_invariant: Slices preserve source dtype, channel identity, and exact indices.
cases.oracle: Independent indexed array values and native napari slice positions agree.

cases.title: Reorder and select displayed axes

reference.behavior: Dims order, transpose, and roll change displayed axes.

cases.required_hooke_interface: Axis reorder controls and explicit displayed-axis selection.
cases.fixture: Asymmetric 5D array with distinct labeled landmarks in every plane.
cases.data_invariant: Reordering presentation never transposes or overwrites the stored resource.
cases.oracle: Independent permutations map the same landmarks and values to the same world positions.

cases.title: Switch between two and three displayed dimensions

reference.behavior: Dims ndisplay and camera state determine 2D and 3D views.

cases.required_hooke_interface: 2D/3D switch with per-view camera and slice state.
cases.fixture: Calibrated 5D intensity, labels, and points.
cases.data_invariant: Each view restores its accepted axes, positions, and camera without changing acquisition.
cases.oracle: Native napari matched view state plus Hooke saved-state equality.

cases.title: Display calibrated coordinates

reference.behavior: Layer transforms relate data coordinates to world coordinates.

cases.required_hooke_interface: Coordinate readout, axis labels, units, and layer transforms.
cases.fixture: Unequal voxel spacing, translated layers, and a known affine transform.
procedure: Select coordinates on each displayed plane.
cases.data_invariant: Units, scale, channel meaning, and source coordinates remain attached to the resource.
cases.oracle: Analytic transform and inverse transform agree within frozen tolerance.

cases.title: Play a dimension forward and backward

reference.behavior: Playback supports signed fps, once, loop, back_and_forth, and frame ranges.
limits: Native playback may drop frames. Native refuses an axis without a slider.

cases.required_hooke_interface: Playback controls with direction, range, speed, and Stop.
cases.fixture: Time series with a unique frame number encoded in pixels.
procedure: Play each supported loop mode and direction.
Attempt an invalid range and a displayed axis.
cases.data_invariant: Rendered frame identity matches displayed data, and Stop does not mutate source values.
cases.oracle: Native terminal positions and loop sequences agree. Dropped intermediate frames are measured, not treated as invented reference failures.

cases.title: Inspect a finite slab

reference.behavior: Image projection modes include none, sum, mean, max, and min with dimension margins.

cases.required_hooke_interface: Slab thickness, projection controls, and explicit conversion action for retained projected data.
cases.fixture: Known uint16 and float slabs with asymmetric margins.
cases.data_invariant: Display projection does not replace raw input. Retained projection records axes, processing, and changed calibration.
cases.oracle: Independent reductions over exactly selected indices match native supported projection modes.

cases.title: Control a three-dimensional camera

reference.behavior: Camera exposes center, zoom, angles, perspective, orientation, and view direction.

cases.required_hooke_interface: Pointer and keyboard camera controls, numeric API, and reset.
cases.fixture: 3D phantom with labeled non-coplanar landmarks.
procedure: Rotate, pan, zoom, change perspective, and reset.
Repeat at different device pixel ratios.
cases.data_invariant: Camera changes affect only the target view unless views are explicitly linked.
cases.oracle: Native and Hooke projected landmark positions agree within frozen screen tolerance.

cases.title: Render all supported volume modes

reference.behavior: Image volume rendering supports translucent, additive, iso, mip, minip, attenuated_mip, and average.

cases.required_hooke_interface: Volume mode controls.
cases.fixture: Volume with gradients, opaque objects, isolated peaks, and known empty regions.
cases.data_invariant: Rendering preserves native numeric data and scientific interpretation.
cases.oracle: Matched native screenshots and analytic projection checks with mode-specific tolerances.

cases.title: Adjust volume appearance

reference.behavior: Volume controls include iso threshold, attenuation, contrast, gamma, and interpolation.

cases.required_hooke_interface: Native-equivalent parameter controls with bounds and descriptions.
cases.fixture: Volume phantom with known threshold crossings and interpolation edges.
procedure: Export a movie using the accepted settings.
cases.data_invariant: Appearance changes do not modify array values. Export records the actual settings.
cases.oracle: Native rendering comparisons at parameter boundaries and independent source hashes.

cases.title: Position image planes and clipping planes

reference.behavior: Scalar fields support plane depiction and layers support clipping planes.

cases.required_hooke_interface: Plane position, normal, thickness, and clipping controls with picking.
cases.fixture: Intersecting transformed volume, points, and mesh.
procedure: Move and rotate the image plane.
cases.data_invariant: Plane and clipping coordinates use the selected view and resource transforms.
cases.oracle: Analytic plane intersection and native visible geometry agree.

cases.data_invariant: Face indices, vertex identities, and associated values remain aligned.

cases.data_invariant: Division edges, time alignment, object identity, and missing observations remain explicit.
cases.oracle: Independent graph isomorphism with preserved IDs and native track positions.

cases.title: Open native arrays without eager materialization

cases.oracle: Actual chunk reads, process-tree/browser/GPU memory, and independent regional values. Logical size alone cannot pass.

cases.fixture: Local multiscale microscopy data with known transforms and asymmetric levels.
cases.data_invariant: Accepted frames name the actual level and region. Calibration remains consistent.
cases.oracle: Native level selection and observed source reads with independent transformed coordinates.

cases.fixture: Cold and warm local/remote chunks with injected latency.

Observe final frame and microscope response.
cases.data_invariant: Old responses never replace a newer accepted selection. Cache and decode buffers stay bounded.
cases.oracle: Request/frame identity traces, actual reads, and pre-frozen latency/memory limits.
